title: Work-symbol relabelling preserves a step
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape machine over a symbol type $\mathrm{Symbol}$ with state type $\mathrm{State}$, and let $e:\mathrm{Symbol}\simeq\mathrm{Symbol}$ be a bijection. For any finite input word over $\mathrm{Symbol}$ and any configuration $d$, taking one step after relabelling the work-tape symbols by $e$ gives the same configuration as taking a step first and then relabelling the work-tape symbols by $e$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape machine over $\mathrm{Symbol}$ with states in $\mathrm{State}$
$e$ is a bijection from $\mathrm{Symbol}$ to itself
the input is a finite word over $\mathrm{Symbol}$
$d$ is a configuration on that input
